2.source: relic set 309 (繁星竞技场 / Celestial Differentiator), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by #1[i]%. When the wearer's current CRIT Rate is equal to or higher than #2[i]%, increases the DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill by #3[i]%." param = [0.08, 0.7, 0.2]
2.note: Two effects, not one, because "Basic ATK and Skill" is a disjunction over CAST CATEGORY and the engine models the two scopes as separate attributes (BASIC_ATTACK_DAMAGE_BOOST / SKILL_DAMAGE_BOOST). A single ALL_DAMAGE_TYPE_BOOST would silently buff ultimates and follow-ups too -- an over-trigger, not a near miss. ⚠ The threshold is a FRACTION: `self_attr:CRIT_CHANCE >= 0.7` means 70%, because every ratio attribute reads as a fraction (the same number `Battle.assemble` compares against `rng.nextDouble()`). Writing `>= 70` would load, look right, and never fire -- the 100x trap this project has hit before (ROADMAP L-9); SelfAttributeConditionTest pins both scales. ⚠ The wearer's own +8% from this set is already in the sheet before BATTLE_START fires (the `properties` stat is applied at construction), so "current CRIT Rate" includes it, as the text intends. ⚠ Same BATTLE_START approximation as sets 301/307 for the word "current".
